title: Proximity Operator of the $\ell_1$ over $\ell_2$ Function
summary: We study the complete, possibly set-valued proximity operator of the nonconvex, scale-invariant ratio \(h(\vx)=\|\vx\|_{1}/\|\vx\|_{2}\). A polar decomposition of the nonzero branch, followed by sign and permutation reductions, transforms the proximal problem into a smooth rank-one quadratic problem over the nonnegative orthant of the unit sphere. After the magnitudes of the data are sorted, every canonical proximal direction belongs to a finite candidate set indexed by its support size \(k\in\{1,\ldots,n\}\).
